display.purpose: Hero headline on the top sheet; max 16ch. Width applied via font-stretch: 72%.

headline.purpose: Section headings. Ranked service names scale from clamp(3rem, 8vw, 6rem) to clamp(1.5rem, 2.6vw, 2.1rem) at width 70%; size encodes how often the service is asked for.

title.purpose: Sheet firm names, copy titles, wordmark, timeline steps (750-800, width 78-80%).

body.purpose: Running text in white; ledes in soft white at about 1.08rem; measure 44-72ch.

label.purpose: White printed field labels, dt terms and chart row labels, uppercase, width 85%.

typed.purpose: Courier Prime electric-ink values: fields, copy, brief values, new-site load values, day numbers, timeline marks; italic for the signature. White for form numbers and the Tear here mark; soft white for old-site load values.

stamp.purpose: The RECEIVED stamp only, uppercase, width 70%, electric ink.

shadows.name: lifted-sheet
shadows.purpose: Every sheet on the slate ground (top sheet, customer copy, brief sheet): lit top edge plus deep black drop.

shadows.name: electric-glow
shadows.purpose: Full-size primary button at rest. The masthead button stays flat.

shadows.name: electric-glow-hover
shadows.purpose: Primary button hover, with a 1px lift.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The single curve for all paper and control motion.

motion.name: tear-off
motion.value: transform/opacity 900ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); to translate(-6%, -40px) rotate(-5deg), opacity 0
motion.purpose: Top sheet tears away on submit. Reduced motion: 200ms linear fade.

motion.name: carbon-transfer
motion.purpose: Each value appearing on the copy. Removed under reduced motion.

motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: Copy straightens after the tear-off. Removed under reduced motion.

motion.name: stamp
motion.value: 380ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) 420ms delay; scale(1.6) to 1 at rotate(-7deg), opacity to 0.92

motion.name: control
motion.purpose: Tick fill, button hover/press (masthead button: colour only), day hover.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Cells and contacts go full width; day strip wraps to 6; nav links drop, masthead button remains.

components.css: .ds-bars{margin:0;max-width:520px;font-family:var(--font-print, Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif);color:var(--text, #f4f6f9)}.ds-bars dl{margin:0;display:grid;gap:14px}.ds-bars-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:6rem 1fr;gap:16px;align-items:center}.ds-bars-row dt{font-size:0.72rem;font-weight:650;font-stretch:85%;letter-spacing:0.08em;text-transform:uppercase}.ds-bars-row dd{margin:0;display:grid;gap:4px}.ds-bar{position:relative;display:block;height:22px;width:calc(var(--w) * 0.8)}.ds-bar-before{background:repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg,rgb(255 255 255 / 0.18) 0 2px,transparent 2px 6px);border:1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.55)}.ds-bar-after{background:var(--electric, #2e6bff)}.ds-bar-value{position:absolute;left:calc(100% + 8px);top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);font-family:var(--font-type, 'Courier Prime', ui-monospace, monospace);font-size:0.95rem;white-space:nowrap;color:var(--text-soft, #a7b2c0)}.ds-bar-after .ds-bar-value{color:var(--electric-text, #6ea2ff)}.ds-bars-key{display:flex;gap:20px;margin:18px 0 0 calc(6rem + 16px);font-size:0.85rem;color:var(--text-soft, #a7b2c0)}.ds-key::before{content:'';display:inline-block;width:14px;height:10px;margin-right:8px;vertical-align:middle}.ds-key-before::before{border:1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.55);background:repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg,rgb(255 255 255 / 0.18) 0 2px,transparent 2px 6px)}.ds-key-after::before{background:var(--electric, #2e6bff)}

narrative.overview:
The whole system is a snap-out triplicate form, set in a premium dark theme. The page is a deep slate ground; content sits on raised slate sheets laid on top of it: a top sheet you fill in, and a cooler customer copy fanned slightly behind it. Everything printed on the form (rules, labels, headings, the masthead) is crisp white. Everything a person writes onto the form (field entries, dates, data values, the signature) is electric blue in Courier Prime. Solid electric blue is the brand accent and marks the few things you press or choose. Red appears only when something is wrong.

Density is that of a real form. Information sits in boxes drawn with 1px translucent white hairlines, labels are small condensed caps printed above each box, and headlines are heavy and very narrow so they fit the way type fits on a printed form. Depth comes from sheets lifting off the dark ground: a faint lit top edge and a deep black drop shadow, at slight rotations. Motion is physical and rare: entries transfer onto the copy as you type, and on submit the top sheet tears away along its perforation and the copy is stamped RECEIVED.

Corners are square everywhere. There is no rounded card language, no gradient fill, and no photography; the only illustration is drawn data (the before/after load-time bar chart).
keyCharacteristics: Deep slate ground, two raised slate sheets on top of it.
White printed type, electric-blue filled-in values; solid electric blue for the brand accent.
Archivo condensed via its width axis for print; Courier Prime for everything typed.
Hairline-boxed form grids; square corners throughout.
Perforations, numbered stubs, slight sheet rotations, deep sheet shadows with a lit top edge.

rules.name: The White Print, Blue Fill Rule
rules.body: Printed things are crisp white Archivo; filled-in things are electric-ink Courier Prime. If a value was written by a person (or stands in for one), it is electric blue. If it would be printed on a blank form, it is white.

rules.name: The Electric Fill Rule
rules.body: Solid electric blue is reserved for the primary action (one per view, plus its compact masthead twin), the one chosen day, and the "after" series of drawn data. Text on it is always white, and it is never used as a section ground, a border colour or decoration.

rules.name: The Error-Only Red Rule
rules.body: Red appears only on an invalid field and its message. It never marks state, success, selection or decoration; those belong to electric blue.

rules.name: The Narrow Is Loud Rule
rules.body: Emphasis comes from weight plus condensing on the width axis, never from extra colour. Headlines sit at width 70–72%; labels at 85%; buttons at 82%; body at 100%.

rules.name: The Typewriter Rule
rules.body: Courier Prime is the typewriter and the numbering machine: filled-in values, chart values, form numbers, the "Tear here" mark. It is never used for headings, labels or buttons.

rules.name: The Lit Edge Rule
rules.body: Shadows belong to sheets and the full-size primary button. Sheets get the lit top edge plus a black drop; the button gets an electric-blue glow. No other element casts a shadow.

dos: **Do** put content on slate sheets laid on the deep slate ground, with the lifted-sheet shadow and a rotation of no more than about 1.5deg.
**Do** draw structure with 1px translucent white hairlines and box every field or data value, with a small condensed uppercase white label printed in its top-left.
**Do** set every filled-in or recorded value in Courier Prime electric ink, and everything printed in white Archivo.
**Do** keep solid electric blue for the primary action, the selected day and the "after" data series, with white text whenever it carries text.
**Do** use the width axis for hierarchy: 70–72% for headlines, 85% for labels.
**Do** use the single ease-out curve (`cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`) for physical paper motion, and provide a reduced-motion fallback for each animation.
**Do** use perforated dot edges and numbered stubs where one sheet hands off to the next.
donts: **Don't** round corners on sheets, cells, fields, bars or buttons; only radio ticks and perforation dots are round.
**Don't** use red for anything except an invalid field and its error message.
**Don't** set small electric-blue (`electric`) text directly on slate; use electric ink for blue text and keep the solid blue for fills.
**Don't** set headings, labels or buttons in Courier Prime, or field values in Archivo.
**Don't** elevate anything inside a sheet except the primary button.
**Don't** draw form fields as filled, bordered boxes; a field is a write-in line.
